checks: Strict incidence gives H>0, positive diagonal heights and positive negated off-diagonal heights. Normal balance is a column identity at each fixed P_j, so a_j=Σ_{i≠j} b_ij; summing yields Σs_i=1. In cyclic order, 2a_i=s_{i+1}−d_{i+1}+s_{i+2}+d_{i+2}, hence g_i=2a_i+s_i>|d_i| and Σg_i=3.

Along each edge from P_i the affine margin crosses zero at fraction a_i/(a_i+b_ij), strictly between zero and one. Their product is the corner area fraction. Expanding the resulting f_i² gives g_i²−d_i²; the positive root is required by f_i=2a_i/√q_i. The moment is exactly 2Σa_i=2.

For cyclic j=i+1, k=i+2, g_j+g_k=3−g_i and d_j−d_k=1−g_i; their difference of squares gives 4(2−g_i). Expanding the remaining difference yields twice g_jg_k+d_jd_k−f_jf_k. The first two terms sum to a positive number because g_j>|d_j| and g_k>|d_k|. Its square minus f_j²f_k² is (g_jd_k+g_kd_j)², so rationalization and (f_j+f_k)>0 prove g_i<2. After division by four and addition of g_i−f_i the two denominators and factors are as stated.

Equality first forces d_i=0. Then g_jd_k+g_kd_j=(d_j+d_k)(1+d_j−d_k)=(d_j+d_k)(2−g_i), whose second factor is strictly positive. The two conditions also suffice and imply g_j=g_k and d_j²=d_k², hence f_j=f_k. The identity and equality conditions are invariant under exchanging j,k.

The corner altitude is Ha_i/||v_i|| and its base is the actual chord length ||v_i||σ_i, so 1/σ_i=Ha_i/(2|K|q_i). As Q>0 and Σa_i=1, a_i=λ_i q_i/Q and substitution gives the stated equivalent inequalities.

overlap.comparison: The same triangle geometry and strict incidence occur there, but that fact derives incidence under a cap ceiling for a positive circuit; it does not compare the signed rows or chord weights.
The positive-normal right-triangle envelope minimizes a single cap over its normal. It supplies no joint signed-height identities, deficit, or chord relation.

That fact bounds a gauge in terms of mixed weights with denominators 2a_i+k_i under criticality and additional fiber assumptions. It neither identifies ordinary signed-height weights nor gives the row deficit.
